categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production and development of materials for the sports industry, focusing on environmentally friendly and sustainable shoe materials. It also engages in the manufacturing of lightweight polyurethane shoe soles and textile coatings using advanced technologies. The business emphasizes product mix adjustment to increase the proportion of high-value products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include the use of bio-based recycled materials certified by ISCC, carbon capture and utilization (CCU) technology for lightweight polyurethane and textile coatings, and supercritical nitrogen foaming technology applied to sports shoe soles and other lightweight applications. The company employs advanced material science and environmentally sustainable production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are in the sports and footwear industries, targeting manufacturers requiring high-performance, lightweight, and sustainable shoe materials. The company serves markets that demand environmentally friendly and innovative material solutions, focusing on maintaining and expanding its presence in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Nantou and Taoyuan. The company has significant shareholder and board member connections with Japanese entities, indicating active engagement in both Taiwanese and Japanese markets. The report does not specify other international markets but suggests a regional focus in East Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing specialized materials and components for footwear manufacturers. It supplies advanced materials that are integrated into finished products by downstream customers in the sports and footwear industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product value through innovation in sustainable materials and advanced manufacturing technologies. R&D focuses on environmental sustainability, such as bio-based materials and carbon capture technologies, as well as improving product performance with lightweight and foaming technologies. The company invests approximately 2.5% of revenue in R&D to support these initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of specialized shoe materials and components. The company maintains a focus on high-value product segments to sustain revenue and profitability growth. There is no indication of subscription or licensing models; income is derived from direct sales to industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a technologically advanced and environmentally conscious supplier in the sports material sector. Its ISCC certification and proprietary technologies provide competitive differentiation in the market, supporting a leadership role in sustainable material innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.65 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing an 11.77% increase over the prior year. Net profit after tax grew by 28.18% to about NT$96 million. Financial indicators show improving profitability and asset returns, reflecting a positive growth trajectory and stable financial scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes sustainable, eco-friendly materials certified by ISCC and innovative production technologies such as CCU and supercritical nitrogen foaming. These capabilities enable it to offer lightweight, high-performance shoe materials that meet environmental standards, providing unique value to customers seeking advanced and sustainable solutions.
